Chapter 6634: Life And Death Tribulation

Chapter 6634: Life And Death Tribulation

“This spring of creation shall be mine today.” She neither denied nor confirmed his claim.

“Alright, let’s see if you have the ability.” Calamities said: “Since you’re dying, I have just the right tribulation as a gift.”

Having said that, he drew forth a bolt from within.

“Ahh!” He bellowed in agony but still pulled it out.

“Crackle!” The bolt greeted everyone with thunderous explosions.

It resembled a trident with flickering flames on the verge of extinguishing, turning from red to black. The bolt was the punishment while the flames were the life force of the punished.

“Life and Death Tribulation!” He shouted.

“Sin of the Heaven!” Staff Ancestor immediately swung her weapon. Space sank downward, unable to bear its weight.

“No punishment.” She then drew a circle around herself. Chaos descended and filled the area inside.

An immemorial light flashed as if an ancient being was being born. The spatial fabrics were torn asunder. A new world meant the end of the old.

Her figure appeared in the chaos but she seemed to be in control of the new world.

“Rumble!” The world’s powers became one for her to use.

“Go!” Calamities threw his bolt forward.

This was her life-or-death tribulation but it also applied to the rest of the world. Everyone watched in horror.

“Sin of the Heaven! Rebirth!” She swung the staff infused with chaos power, sending out her lightning bolt filled with life force.

The particles emanating from it created numerous worlds, attempting to stop the incoming bolt. Anything touched by it was burned to ashes. It became a contest between creation and destruction.

Calamities’ tribulation was boundless, capable of engulfing worlds.

“Sin of the Heaven! True Immortal!” She changed something in the chaos, creating a seed of a true immortal.

This seed slammed into the bolt, not relenting an inch. Both sides had infinite power.

“...” Apex primal ancestors became emotional since these exchanges could have killed them numerous times over.

Worlds and cycles took place in seconds. This was the difference between overlords and them.

“We’ll see if you can escape.” Calamities headed for the spring.

Staff Ancestor was preoccupied with the tribulation, unable to stop him. After all, he had lived longer and possessed mighty tribulations. Staff Ancestor appeared to be slightly weaker.

“It’s his.” Someone said.

“Now!” Calamities reached for the spring.

A square seal suddenly appeared from the spring and unleashed a supreme world against Calamities. Three Immortals looked tiny in comparison.

Calamities reacted swiftly and assumed a defensive pose against a direct impact.

“Bam!” He staggered backward repeatedly; his energy became unstable.
